name.description: Who to greet; defaults to Anish Mitta

tools.name: gmail_list_threads
tools.description: List Gmail thread IDs, optionally filtered by a Gmail search query (e.g. 'is:unread'). Use gmail_get_thread to read a thread's messages.

tools.name: gmail_get_thread
tools.description: Read a Gmail thread: sender, subject, date, snippet, and read/unread state for each message. Use gmail_mark_read to mark messages as read.

tools.name: gmail_mark_read
tools.description: Mark Gmail messages as read, in bulk, by message ID.

ids.description: Gmail message IDs to mark as read

tools.name: gmail_create_filter
tools.description: Create a Gmail filter that automatically applies a behavior (archive / archive+mark-read / trash) to incoming messages matching a sender, subject, or query. Use when the user no longer wants certain emails in their inbox.

subject.description: Match text in the subject line

query.description: Raw Gmail search query for advanced matching

behavior.description: archive: skips inbox. archive_and_mark_read: skips inbox, arrives as read. trash: arrives in trash.

label.description: Label to add to matching messages; must exist (see gmail_list_labels). Omit for none.

tools.name: gmail_list_filters
tools.description: List all Gmail filters with their match criteria and actions (labels added, inbox/read changes). Use to review automation before changing it.

tools.name: gmail_delete_filter
tools.description: Delete a Gmail filter by ID (from gmail_list_filters). Takes effect immediately; does not undo actions the filter already applied to existing messages.

tools.name: gmail_discard_draft
tools.description: Permanently delete a Gmail draft by ID (from gmail_list_drafts). Irreversible — the draft is discarded immediately and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft (saved to Drafts, never sent). For a reply, pass the threadId from gmail_get_thread and phrase the subject as a reply (e.g. 'Re: ...').

threadId.description: Thread to reply within (from gmail_get_thread); omit for a fresh draft

tools.name: gmail_bulk_mark_read
tools.description: Bulk-mark Gmail messages as read by search query (default 'is:unread', limit 100). One-call triage for inbox noise; use a narrow query when unsure.

q.description: Gmail search query selecting what to mark read

limit.description: Max messages to mark (batchModify caps at 1000)

tools.name: gmail_list_labels
tools.description: List Gmail labels (system + user labels) with their IDs. Use an ID as the `label` argument of gmail_create_filter, or before filtering to check a label exists.

tools.name: gmail_label_messages
tools.description: Add a Gmail label to existing messages. Use gmail_list_labels to get valid label IDs — filter labels only apply to future mail, this applies to messages already received.

labelId.description: Label ID to add (use gmail_list_labels to find IDs, e.g. 'Label_619019205227046583')
